paite: Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu gen un; Amah lah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna leng tangtawn a om ding ahih ziak in.
heading: Vualzohna Ziak A Kipahna Thumna
english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding chih Israelte'n gen uhen.
english: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding chih, Aaron inkuante'n gen uhen.
english: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding chih, TOUPA kihtate'n gen uhen.
english: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: Ka mangbatna a kipan in TOUPA ka sam a, TOUPA'N hon dawng a, mun awngthawl ah hon omsakta hi.
english: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.

paite: TOUPA kei lam a pang ahi a, ka lau kei ding; mihing in bang ahon chih thei dia.
english: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

paite: TOUPA kei lam a pang hon panpihte lak a ahi; huaiziak in hon doute tung ah ka thu deihtel ka mu ding hi.
english: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

paite: Mihing muan sang in TOUPA a muanna koih ahoihzaw hi.
english: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.

paite: Miliante gintak sang in TOUPA a ginna koih ahoihzaw hi.
english: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.

paite: Nam chih in ahon umsuak ua; amau TOUPA min in ka hihmang ding.
english: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name I cut them off.

paite: Amau hon umsuak ua; ahi, hon umsuak ua; amau TOUPA min in ka hihmang ding hi.
english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.

paite: Khuai bang in hon umsuak ua; ling meikuang bang in mihsak in a-om uh; amau TOUPA min in ka hihmang ding hi.
english: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.

paite: Ka pukna ding in hon sut na tum a; himahleh TOUPA'N ahon panpih geih hi.
english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.

paite: TOUPA ka hatna leh ka la ahi, ka hotdamna leng ahong hita hi.
english: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

paite: Kipahna leh hotdamna husa midiktatte puanin ah a-om hi, TOUPA khut taklam in hangsantak in ahih nak hi.
english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.

paite: TOUPA khut taklam pahtawi in a-om nak a; TOUPA khut taklam in hangsantak in ahih nak hi.
english: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”

paite: Ka si kei ding, ka dam ding hi, TOUPA thilhihte ka theisak zaw ding.
english: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.

paite: TOUPA'N nakpitak in hon thuzoh a, sihna kiang ah zaw hon pe tel kei hi.
english: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

paite: Diktatna kulh kongkhakte hon honsak un; huaite ah ka lut ding a, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu ka hilh ding hi.
english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.

paite: Hiai TOUPA kongkhak ahi; midiktatte alut ding uh.
english: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.

paite: Na kiang ah kipahthu ka gen ding, nang hon dawng in, hon hondampa na hita ngal a.
english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

paite: Inn lamte suang deih louh aning a suang phatuampen ana hita hi.
english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

paite: Huai TOUPA hih ahi; i mitmuh uah alamdang ahi.
english: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

paite: Hiai TOUPA ni seh ahi, hiai ah i nuam un i kipak ding uh.
english: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

paite: TOUPA aw, hehpih in hon hondam inla, TOUPA aw, hehpih in vangphatna hon sawl in.
english: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.

paite: TOUPA min a hong pai in nuam asa hi; TOUPA' inn a pan in ka hon vualzawl uhi.
english: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.

paite: TOUPA Pathian ahi, ama'n vak ahon pia a, kithoihna ding khauhual in khih uhen, maitam kii mahmah ah.
english: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

paite: Nang ka Pathian na hi a, kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a; ka Pathian na hi a, ka hon pahtawi ding hi.
english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

paite: Aw, TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; amah lah ahoih ngala; azahngaihna lah tangtawn a om ding ahi ngal a.
english: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
